decision.hint: Tenjin router can run this step on any of these models, no API key needed: gpt-image-2.5 = GPT Image 2.5 Flare, closest prompt following and text in the image, $0.115; nano-banana-2.1 = Nano Banana 2.1, photoreal scenes and consistent subjects, $0.095; grok-imagine-2 = Grok Imagine Image 2.0, fast photoreal and bold stylized art, $0.043; all = every one side by side, $0.253 in total. Tenjin reviewed these listings. If the user named a model or asked to compare, use that. Otherwise, if a person is present, ask them once with your own picker (such as AskUserQuestion) which one, or all; if not, use gpt-image-2.5. Then call request({id: "8f0c2b7e-3d41-4a6f-9c25-7e1d0b9a4c11", choice: "<gpt-image-2.5|nano-banana-2.1|grok-imagine-2|all>", input: {"prompt":"<prompt>"}}) alone and wait for its result. When the choice is all, look at each saved file and tell the user which fits best. Tell the user which model you used through Tenjin and what it cost.
